picks.title: Anthropic's best AI model struggles to attract users as cheaper tools thrive
picks.why_it_matters: Signals a potential market shift where AI commoditization is accelerating faster than expected, creating openings for startups building cost-efficient or specialized AI tooling rather than competing on raw model performance.

picks.title: Texas welcomed the AI boom. Now Abbott says data centers 'dug their own grave'
picks.why_it_matters: Growing bipartisan backlash against AI infrastructure creates regulatory risk for compute-heavy startups while opening opportunities in energy-efficient AI, edge computing, and grid solutions.

picks.title: Flock cameras join data centers as a top AI boogeyman in 2026 midterms
picks.why_it_matters: Surveillance tech facing political headwinds suggests due diligence on AI/computer vision deals should now include regulatory scenario planning, while privacy-first alternatives may see tailwinds.
